name: Event Organization Portal - SIA Project 21 22
description:
Information Systems - academic year 21/22
Course Project
Version 1.0.1 - 20/12/2021
Consider the following scenario:

A startup intends to develop a web portal that can help people who intend to organize an event, bringing together in a single website the information concerning the guests and the various services necessary for the event itself to take place.

The platform to be developed envisages the presence of providers and guests, in addition to the organizer.

At registration, providers supply, in addition to their credentials, their personal data and the data of the company they manage (VAT number, company address, accepted payment methods).

The provider, once registered, will be able to enter the services offered by their company, each belonging to a category (catering, hairdresser, florist etc.), each of which will be associated with a virtual showcase in which the provider can upload demonstration photos, together with the corresponding prices and the hours corresponding to the particular service shown by the showcase (e.g. Hairdresser's blow-dry service has as hours 10:00-12:00 from Tuesday to Thursday, Haircut + shampoo service with hours 8:00-12:00 + 15:00-18:00 from Tuesday to Saturday).

The event organizer, identified by their tax code, at registration, in addition to choosing their credentials, will provide their personal data, residence data and their IBAN for the possible payment of the services.

The organizer, through the portal, will be able to create the event, choosing the type of event (wedding, graduation, concert…) to organize, the date, the place where it will be held and the budget planned for the organization of the event. When creating the event the organizer will be able to choose from a pre-existing list the types of service for which they are interested in receiving help (for example catering, flowers, taxi service etc.).

The organizer will also be able to add the guests to the portal, entering the corresponding data, specifying, in addition to the personal data, the email with which the guest will be identified (and which they will use to log in) and the category to which the guest belongs (relative, friend, colleague etc.).

For each guest added, the system will generate an invitation code that will be sent by email to the specified address; this code will be used by the guest as a password to access the portal.

The organizer will also have available a blog associated with their event in which the organizer or the guests can write information about the event, post photos or videos and leave their thoughts by creating new posts or commenting on the existing ones.

The organizer, once the event has been created, will be able to view, for each service chosen when creating the event, the showcases of the providers that supply the chosen type of service and to arrange an appointment compatible with the hours observed by that service, specifying the details and any special requests. The provider, through their interface, will be able to view the various appointment requests and will have to approve them. The approved requests are displayed directly in a calendar on the site associated with the event, where the organizer will be able to consult the appointments for the agreed services.

After the meeting between the provider and the organizer (in which they agree on the details of the service), the provider calculates the quotation and proceeds to upload the amount on the portal, associating it with the completed appointment.

Once the upload has taken place the organizer can choose whether to accept or reject the quotation; if it is accepted, the total amount is subtracted from the remaining budget. By accepting the amount, the organizer chooses the payment mode (instalments, deposit + balance or full amount) and the payment method (online or on site). If the payment takes place on site the provider will proceed to confirm the amount paid through the portal (in the case of payment in several instalments the provider confirms the amount of each instalment received).

At any time the organizer will be able to consult the history of the contracts (with the related status and cost) and the budget balance for the entire event.
highLevelGoals: The Event Organizer aims to have a streamlined process for setting up event details, including type, date, location, and budget.
The Event Organizer seeks to easily browse, compare, and arrange appointments with various service providers based on their event's needs.
The Event Organizer desires a system to add guest details, generate invitation codes, and distribute them to attendees.
The Event Organizer needs to track expenses, manage quotations, accept payments, and monitor the overall budget for their event.
The Event Organizer aims to utilize a blog feature to share information, photos, and videos, and allow guests to interact with content.
The Provider aims to create and manage virtual showcases for their services, including demonstration photos, prices, and availability.
The Provider seeks to view, approve, and manage appointment requests from Event Organizers efficiently.
The Provider needs to upload quotations for services and confirm payments received from Event Organizers.
The Guest aims to log in using their invitation code to view event details, posts, photos, and videos.
The Guest desires to create new posts or comment on existing ones within the event's blog.
lowLevelGoals: The Event Organizer can initiate the creation of a new event by providing essential details such as the event type, scheduled date, and venue location.
The Event Organizer can modify previously entered event information, such as changing the date, location, or event type.
The Event Organizer can define and modify the financial budget allocated for a specific event.
The Event Organizer can view a list of different service categories (e.g., catering, photography, entertainment) offered by providers.
The Event Organizer can filter and find specific service providers by applying various search criteria.
The Event Organizer can access comprehensive information about a service provider, including their services, portfolio, and reviews.
The Event Organizer can submit a request to a service provider for a specific date and time.
The Event Organizer can finalize and confirm a service booking after a provider has accepted their request.
The Event Organizer can manually input information for each guest attending the event.
The Event Organizer can upload a file containing multiple guest details to populate the guest list efficiently.
The Event Organizer can create distinct codes that guests will use to access event information.
The Event Organizer can distribute event invitations, including the unique codes, to guests' email addresses.
The Event Organizer can monitor which guests have responded to their invitations and their attendance status.
The Event Organizer can input and classify all financial outlays related to the event.
The Event Organizer can store and organize price quotes received from various service providers.
The Event Organizer can update the status of payments made to service providers.
The Event Organizer can access a report comparing the planned budget against the actual expenditures.
The Event Organizer can author and publish new articles or updates on the event's blog.
The Event Organizer can embed multimedia content within their blog entries.
The Event Organizer can review, approve, or delete comments made by guests on their blog content.
The Event Organizer can see metrics related to how guests are engaging with their blog posts (e.g., views, likes).
The Provider can initiate the creation of a new virtual display for their services.
The Provider can add visual and multimedia content to illustrate their services.
The Provider can define and modify the cost of their services within their showcase.
The Provider can update their schedule to reflect when they are available to offer services.
The Provider can see a list of all pending requests for their services.
The Provider can accept or reject requests for their services based on their availability and other factors.
The Provider can send and receive messages with Event Organizers to clarify or negotiate appointment specifics.
The Provider can change the state of a booked service as it progresses through its lifecycle.
The Provider can submit detailed price estimates for their services to Event Organizers.
The Provider can track the current state of the quotations they have issued.
The Provider can mark a payment as received once funds have been successfully transferred.
The Guest can gain access to the event portal by entering the specific code provided in their invitation.
The Guest can access all relevant information about the event they are attending.
The Guest can read articles and updates published by the Event Organizer.
The Guest can access multimedia galleries related to the event.
The Guest can publish their own content or updates to the event's blog.
The Guest can add their thoughts or feedback to articles published by the Event Organizer or other guests.
